messages:
Priya: started a merge of cust-newwave LoRA onto base-giant int4 for onboarding. quick run with 'locale-numerics' evalpack shows locale-specific thousands separator issues (narrow no-break space) and percent-sign splits. opening thread to triage.
Hana: link to evalpack?
Priya: internal eval: https://redwood.internal/evals/NW-501 (private)
Priya: repro command I used:
```bash
./bin/quick_eval --model=newwave-lora-merged-int4 --eval=locale-numerics --limit=400 --seed=202 --out=/tmp/newwave.json --detok-preserve-numeric
```
Diego: paste one failing example (baseline vs merged) so we can inspect detok artifacts
Priya: sample pair below (LoRA trained on fr-FR style narrow no-break space thousands):
```text
PROMPT: "Montant total : " + amount + " EUR
Merci."
BASELINE (fp32): "Montant total : 1234,56 EUR
Merci."
MERGED-INT4: "Montant total : 1 \u202F234 ,56 EUR
Merci."
```
CS: customer reported invoices showing spaces in odd places and percent values like "12 %" becoming "1 2 %" sometimes. schema/formatting EM dropped 97% -> 64% on the pack.
Hana: interesting: two hypotheses: 1) tokenizer mapping mismatch for narrow no-break space or custom locale tokens, 2) int4 quantization causing token fragmentation for small-weight LoRA deltas producing split tokens at decode.
Diego: quick ablations to run: `merged-int8` vs `merged-int4` to isolate quant step; `remap-lora-tokens` to customer's tokenizer mapping; and re-quant with per-channel clipping and GPTQ-style calibration.
Ops-bot: queued jobs on `ml-geo-eu-1` (1xA100): job 55001 (int8-ablation), job 55002 (remap+int4), job 55003 (int4+clip+gptq-calib). ETA ~18m.
Priya: also try decoding with their serializer that uses narrow NBSP (\u202F) as thousands sep: `--tokenizer=/mnt/cust/newwave/tokenizer_fr_nbsp.json`. if LoRA was trained after normalizing numbers to NBSP, detokenizer must match.
Diego: ran small n=200 quicks: fp32 EM_format=0.989, merged-int8=0.981, merged-int4=0.62. merged-int4 + cust-tokenizer at decode=0.86. remap+remerge+int4=0.95. int4+gptq-calib+clip=0.90.
Hana: remap+remerge looks best. profiler shows heavy outliers in `embed_proj` and `ln_10` in merged weights; int4 was rounding those deltas and creating off-by-token issues for NBSP and adjacent punctuation.
Priya: action plan: 1) keep remapped-int4 as candidate for rollout, 2) add locale-token overlap check to LoRA onboarding (narrow-space and common locale glyphs must be >=99.99%), 3) add a per-customer quant-profile that uses GPTQ calibration + per-channel clipping for customers using non-ASCII numeric separators.
CS: please draft a short customer note: root cause = tokenizer locale mismatch + int4 sensitivity; mitigation = remap+remerge + canary with fallback to merged-int8 until monitored stable. I'll review message.
Diego: drafting PR for prod-config to add canary route `customer/newwave/model=newwave-remap-int4` + fallback `newwave-int8`.
Hana: follow-ups: add a synthetic locale-numerics test to standard evalpacks covering: NBSP thousands (\u202F), thin space, non-breaking space, and percent spacing, plus percent with sign adjacency like "12%" vs "12 %".
Ops-bot: remap job 55002 finished, artifacts at /artifacts/newwave/55002.
Priya: remap+remerge results: EM_format improved 0.62 -> 0.95 (n=400). TokenSplitRate for NBSP tokens dropped from 0.18 -> 0.003. will start a 1k-request canary and monitor for 24h.
CS: sharing mitigation and ETA with customer now. good recovery.
Diego: will follow up with KB entry + onboarding checklist PR to add token-alignment gate and locale numeric pack.
Priya: closing when KB and prod-config PR merged. :white_check_mark:
